Report
I, S2 [ILLEGIBLE], was brought by the sergeant on duty to reinforce surveillance at this DPV-DT's microwave installation, because an alert had been given about a possible attack on the THF station, also belonging to this DPV-DT.
After arriving at the designated location, I saw an object resembling an airplane. Soon after flying overhead, it returned very low with colored lights and performed several aerobatic maneuvers. I fired three shots; when I fired [CROSSED OUT] shots, it went away.
After the object left I was quite shaken and had the impression [CROSSED OUT] that I had seen some figures in the scrubland. This made me fire two more shots.
Gama, June 20, 1978.
S2 [ILLEGIBLE SIGNATURE]

Quando de serviço no dia 22 de agosto de 1978, fomos interrogados pelo Comandante do QD-460, sobre a existência de tráfego na posição, em relação aos ponteiros do relógio, 09:00 horas.
Diante da nossa negativa informou o tráfego na citada posição; quando inquerido sobre a existência de tal tráfego, voltou a confirmar a existência de tal e posteriormente informou haver desaparecido. Isto se deu a 65NM fora de Brasília.

source_image_corrections.translation:
While on duty on August 22, 1978, we were questioned by the captain of QD-460 about the presence of traffic at the nine o'clock position.
After we replied in the negative, he reported traffic at that position. When asked about the presence of this traffic, he confirmed it again and later reported that it had disappeared. This occurred 65NM outside Brasília.
